metadata.author: Josh Fleishman
metadata.description: The Bedtime Scientist is a calm science podcast for curious kids and their grownups, told in one steady, gentle voice. Each episode explores a real scientific wonder like rainbows, butterflies, sleep, volcanoes, deep ocean life, or the stars in a way that is sensory-friendly, low stimulation, and easy to settle into at bedtime. There are no loud sound effects, no chaotic characters, and no fast, jarring energy. Just real science, quiet curiosity, and a soothing listening experience that works especially well for neurodiverse kids and families who want something trustworthy at the end of the day.
